mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in RSAFS (consumer credit demand) and rise in FEDFUNDS (tightening) signals credit contraction and economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with weak credit demand
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing weakness that precedes equity market corrections, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer spending and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment expansion, a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market cooling that precedes equity market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of low unemployment expansion periods when PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals synchronized labor and manufacturing deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
